help.resultPartial: {{imported}} imported, {{failed}} not imported — see the reasons below.
help.sheets: Only the sheet "Fill Here" is read. Keep the sheet names "How To" and "Fill Here" and the header row unchanged.

howTo.doNotRename: Do not rename the sheets "{{howTo}}" and "{{fill}}", and do not rename, add, remove or reorder the header columns.
howTo.fillSheet: Fill the sheet "{{sheet}}": one record per row, starting on row 2.
howTo.formats: Dates: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-07-01). Numbers: digits with a dot as decimal separator (e.g. 1250.5). Yes/No columns: Yes or No.
howTo.noFormulas: Enter plain values only: formulas and values starting with =, +, - or @ are rejected.
howTo.requiredColumns: Columns marked "Required" must be filled; "Optional" columns may be left empty.
howTo.upload: Save the file as .xlsx, upload it, review the preview, select the rows to import and confirm. Invalid or duplicate rows are reported and never block the valid rows.
